title: Business Development Manager/Senior Manager – Private Capital & Life Sciences
description: Overview of the firm and function Freshfields US LLP is a major international law firm, providing legal advice of the highest quality. We want to be the law firm that clients turn to for legal advice where it matters most, wherever in the world that may be. We deliver seamless client service across borders, cultures, and languages. Our people make our firm – we are a people business and want to create a welcoming and supportive environment where all can flourish. We see diversity as a strength which creates fresh perspectives and generates new ideas. We enjoy our work and are determined to do an outstanding job. We deliver best when working in teams. We think and work globally – we don’t just say we are one firm; we act like one firm right across the world. We work wherever our clients need us. This is how we define ourselves, not by reference to where we have offices. Cross-border work isn’t just what we do, it is what we excel at. We understand what it really takes to work across different legal systems and commercial environments and to bridge language and cultural gaps. We aim to add value in everything we do – we are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We use our experience and creativity to help clients make judgments and achieve their goals. In everything we do, we seek to make a real difference to the communities in which we operate. About Marketing & Business Development (MBD) MBD is a dynamic global team which includes business development professionals, research analysts, brand, marketing and communications experts. By working collaboratively, our team shapes the firm’s client strategy, completes analysis of complex business issues, targets opportunities, develops compelling proposals and creates content and marketing campaigns that lead our digital presence. Together, we define the client experience and shape the perception of Freshfields around the globe. Key Responsibilities and Deliverables This is a varied role requiring excellent teamworking and communication skills as well as the ability to build strong, trusted relationships with senior internal stakeholders and client contacts, and to work collaboratively with brand, marketing, communications, research and business development professionals across our global firm. We are seeking a Business Development Manager/Senior Manager to guide our strategic business development efforts from our new Boston office, focused on the Private Capital and Life Sciences sectors. Both Private Capital and Life Sciences are key sectors within Freshfields, lying at the very heart of our growth plans for the firm, underpinned by the opening of our Boston office in 2025. The successful candidate will work closely with our leading Private Capital and Life Sciences partners across the US to identify client issues, map out market trends and create an engaging program of client development activities to drive revenue in these practice areas on a global basis and with special focus on the Boston market. This role will be part of the firm’s global MBD function and will report to the US Head of MBD, working as an integral member of the global sector MBD team. With this context, the Business Development Manager/Senior Manager – Private Capital & Life Sciences will be responsible for working collaboratively with Boston‑based partners and key partners in other US offices, as well as with colleagues across the Global Marketing & Business Development team to: 1. Strategic Business Development & Planning Lead and support the development and execution of a focused business development strategy for the Private Capital and Life Sciences sectors in Boston, aligned with the firm’s US and global priorities. Work with Private Capital partners to identify the specific challenges and opportunities in the private equity, venture/growth, and broader private capital ecosystem, and translate these into concrete client development initiatives and revenue‑generation plans. Work with Life Sciences partners across the firm to identify the specific challenges and opportunities in the life sciences, biotechnology, medtech and related venture/growth areas and translate these into concrete client development initiatives and revenue‑generation plans. Actively contribute Boston and New England market intelligence and trends into the firm’s global MBD initiatives, ensuring local developments inform our broader sector strategy. Support the creation and regular review of an annual BD and marketing plan (including targets, key accounts, campaigns, and events) with clear objectives, timelines and metrics for success. 2. Client Development, Targeting & Pipeline Management Work with partners to develop, implement and track client targeting initiatives, including key account plans for priority clients, funds, and sponsors in the Boston market and beyond. Use CRM and marketing technology tools to track key relationships, monitor pipeline activity, and generate actionable insights that support strategic business opportunities and cross‑selling across practice groups and geographies. Map relationships across target organizations and the broader market, identifying decision makers, influencers, and alumni connections to support partner outreach and relationship‑building. Support partners in preparing for client meetings (briefing notes, talking points, follow‑up actions) and ensure systematic follow‑up, including entry of activities and opportunities into the firm’s CRM. 3. Pitching, Proposals & Panel Submissions Lead the development of compelling credentials, capability statements, proposals, and pitches to respond to fast‑turnaround opportunities, strategic panel appointments, and RFPs in the Private Capital and Life Sciences spaces. Work closely with partners, lawyers, pricing, and other business services teams to tailor messaging, differentiate the firm’s value proposition, and ensure client‑centric, outcome‑focused materials. Maintain and continually enhance a library of sector‑specific credentials, experience lists, and case studies, ensuring Boston matters and lawyers are accurately reflected. Coordinate and support the firm’s relevant legal directory and award submissions (e.g., Chambers, Legal 500), including matter selection, content drafting and referees tracking. 4. Market Positioning, Thought Leadership & Campaigns Help develop sector‑specific content and campaigns to increase engagement with key clients and prospects and to enhance the personal brands of leading attorneys and the firm’s reputation in Boston and globally. Plan and execute thought leadership initiatives (such as client alerts, market reports, and topical briefings) in collaboration with partners, knowledge lawyers, and communications colleagues, ensuring consistent quality and timely delivery. Support and, where appropriate, lead the planning and delivery of client events, roundtables, sponsorships, and conference participation that raise the profile of the firm’s Boston practice groups and foster deeper client relationships in the region. Work with research and analytics colleagues to conduct market, competitor, and client analyses that inform go‑to‑market strategies, sector campaigns, and client conversations. 5. Collaboration Across MBD, Marketing & the Firm Build trusted relationships with MBD colleagues across sectors, practices, and regions, and actively contribute to a “one team” global mindset in the support of priority clients and opportunities. Partner closely with brand, marketing, digital, and communications teams to ensure that the Private Capital and Life Sciences practices are integrated into firmwide campaigns, digital channels, and media efforts. Help manage and continuously improve the internal structure and tools for the sector, including practice groups’ SharePoint or Teams sites, capability statements, credentials, and internal folders, ensuring information is current, organized, and easy to access. Support the development and enhancement of sector and practice group data, including liaising with the CRM and data teams and relevant Executive Assistants to improve processes and increase data sharing and accuracy. 6. Stakeholder Engagement & Internal Communication Build strong, trusted relationships with Boston‑based lawyers, as well as key partners in other US offices and globally, serving as a proactive advisor on BD and marketing opportunities. Provide regular updates to partners on BD initiatives, pipeline status, campaign performance, and market developments, including concise reporting on key metrics and outcomes. Contribute to continuous improvement in the firm’s approach to BD, including proactive sharing of knowledge, data, and best practices through centralized tools and forums. Key Qualifications (skills/experience) Required Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university, ideally in business, marketing, communications, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in business development and/or marketing in a professional services environment; law firm or financial services sector experience strongly preferred. Strong communication skills, with attention to detail in writing. Demonstrated experience supporting sector‑focused and/or practice‑focused business development initiatives, ideally involving corporate, financial institutions, or private capital clients. Proven track record in preparing and managing pitches, proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations for sophisticated institutional clients. Strong project management experience with evidence of successfully managing multiple concurrent initiatives, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast‑paced environment and meet strict, often quickly evolving deadlines. Extensive working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel). Strongly Preferred Experience working with private equity, venture capital, growth equity, or other private capital clients, with asset management/financial institutions more broadly, or with the life sciences sector. Knowledge of or experience in the Boston legal, financial, life sciences, or private capital markets. Familiarity or experience working with the life sciences sector would be considered an asset. Experience using CRM systems and BD/marketing technology platforms such as Salesforce, Foundation, as well as Generative AI tools. Familiarity with databases such as PitchBook, Preqin, Refinitiv, Mergermarket, Capital IQ, or comparable market intelligence tools. Skills and Competencies Strategic and analytical thinker, able to interpret market and client information and translate it into practical BD actions and partner‑ready recommendations. Strong emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the confidence to interact with and influence partners and senior stakeholders while maintaining diplomacy and discretion. Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with meticulous attention to detail in drafting and editing client‑facing materials. Highly collaborative team player who builds strong internal networks and works effectively across offices, practices, and business services teams. Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and tight deadlines without compromising quality. Comfort with data, reporting, and use of CRM and marketing technology to monitor activity, measure impact, and inform decision‑making. Proactive, self‑motivated, and resourceful, with a natural curiosity and dedication to ongoing learning and professional growth as a well‑rounded BD practitioner. Travel / Work Environment Occasional travel may be required to other US offices or to client and industry events, consistent with business needs. The role operates in a fast‑paced, collaborative professional services environment, requiring flexibility to work additional hours as necessary to meet deadlines and support time‑sensitive client opportunities. title: Senior Business Development Manager - TMT
description: We are seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead our strategic business development efforts for our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) sector across the US market , with a particular focus on artificial intelligence . The successful candidate will work closely with our leading AI partners to identify client issues, map out market trends and create an engaging program of client development activities to drive revenue from this sector, with a primary focus on the US and in close collaboration with colleagues internationally. They will also be responsible for developing a market-leading communications strategy that delivers on our TMT brand aspirations in the US, with AI as a central pillar. This is a high-profile role for a key sector within Freshfields, which lies at the very heart of our growth plans for the firm — and nowhere more so than in the US market . This growth has been underpinned by our Silicon Valley office , which positions Freshfields at the epicenter of the world's AI ecosystem. We have close relationships with several of the most important clients in this space, ranging from "Big Tech" companies and frontier AI companies based on the West Coast to AI infrastructure players , AI-enabled disruptors , and emerging companies evolving into industry household names. The rapid pace of AI development — spanning regulation, investment, M&A, and governance — makes this an exceptionally dynamic and strategically critical role within our broader TMT offering. Key Responsibilities and Deliverables Drawing on support from across the MBD function and the wider firm, the successful candidate will use their knowledge, skills and experience to: Support US AI client strategy and internal reporting, with a particular focus on AI-driven priorities and opportunities within the US TMT market ; Develop an excellent understanding of the US TMT market, with deep expertise in AI , using this to anticipate revenue-generating opportunities — including those arising from AI regulatory developments, M&A activity in the AI sector, AI governance frameworks, and data-related legal trends — and to adapt the US marketing and business development approach accordingly, such that client outreach and collateral can be generated quickly; Work very closely with partners in the US to take advantage of these opportunities and help develop opportunities with our priority and target clients, by tailoring and positioning key legal and market developments — particularly in AI , such as emerging legislation, enforcement actions, and compliance requirements — in ways that are specifically relevant for them; Take the lead on working with client teams to develop the relationships they have with priority clients across the US TMT landscape, with an emphasis on AI-driven companies and sectors , so that we are a compelling choice for these clients when it comes to the work we want to win. We aim both to drive revenue through increased penetration of existing firm clients (across US offices, practice groups, and, where relevant, international geographies) and by identifying select new clients — particularly within the AI ecosystem — that fit our longer-term strategy; Be a constant source of advice, expertise and coaching for all TMT lawyers and MBD colleagues in the US, such that they see you as the go-to person for business development initiatives and client insight, especially on AI-related matters ; Work with colleagues in MBD to develop a market-leading communications strategy that delivers on our TMT brand aspirations in the US , leveraging the firm's Silicon Valley presence and AI focus as key differentiators; Take the MBD lead on all major US TMT projects, particularly those with an AI dimension , including product working groups and client targeting initiatives; Work closely with our TMT lawyers to support strategically important pitches effectively, including drafting content that reflects the firm's depth and credibility in AI-related legal services ; Coach and manage colleagues, both formally in the case of their direct reports and informally with respect to the rest of the MBD function, fostering AI sector knowledge and fluency across the team. title: Student-stage - Corporate

title: Compliance Analyst
description: Role Summary The Compliance Analyst is a newly created role within the Internal Audit team, with a specific brief to assess compliance across the firm, focused primarily on financial compliance. The role will undertake targeted compliance reviews, recurring monitoring and data-driven testing to identify areas of non-compliance, control weakness and reporting improvement. The firm is seeking an individual who will bring energy, curiosity and new ideas to compliance monitoring, helping to modernise the use of data, analytics, reporting and technology-enabled assurance across the Internal Audit function. The position will support the development of a stronger, more consistent compliance monitoring framework across key financial processes, working closely with Internal Audit colleagues and with stakeholders in Finance, Financial Systems, Data, the Legal Department and Financial reporting teams. The role will help improve the quality, consistency and usefulness of reporting, including the development of dashboards, exception reporting and management information. Initial areas of focus are expected to include travel and expenses, billing and write-off authorisations, payment authorisations, banking authorisations and access, and controls over systems access, including the timely removal or amendment of access for leavers and movers. The role may also support assessment of matter management compliance, including Client Due Diligence, engagement letters and sanctions compliance, as well as anti-bribery and corruption compliance relating to gifts and hospitality. The successful candidate will be analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable working across teams to understand processes, test compliance and explain findings clearly. The role requires a practical, collaborative and improvement-focused approach, while maintaining the independence and objectivity expected of Internal Audit. The position will be based primarily in the firm's Manchester office. There may be periodic need to travel to London office but this role is not expected to entail significant travel. Key responsibilities Plan and deliver targeted compliance reviews and monitoring activities focused on financial compliance risks across the firm. Assess compliance with policies, procedures and approval requirements in areas such as travel and expenses, billing, write-off authorisations, payment approvals and banking authorisations. Perform data analysis and exception testing to identify non-compliance, control gaps, trends and emerging risk areas Develop and enhance data-driven compliance monitoring techniques, leveraging analytics and automation to improve coverage, efficiency and insight Perform periodic user access reviews across key systems, assessing the appropriateness of access rights, segregation of duties and privileged access arrangements Support the assessment of information security and data protection controls, including compliance with policies governing confidential client information, personal data and other sensitive firm information Identify opportunities to strengthen compliance oversight through improved use of data, technology, dashboards and automated exception reporting. Coordinate improvements in compliance reporting, working with Financial Systems, Data and other reporting teams to improve the quality, consistency and usability of management information. Assess selected matter management compliance activities, which may include Client Due Diligence, engagement letters and sanctions compliance. Review anti-bribery and corruption compliance relating to gifts and hospitality, including adherence to policy requirements and approval processes. Document findings, root causes, recommendations and agreed actions in a clear, concise and evidence-based manner. Track and validate remediation actions arising from compliance reviews working with internal auditors where a process or control improvement is recommended. Build constructive working relationships with Finance, the Legal Department, Financial Systems, Data and business stakeholders across the firm. Support wider Internal Audit assignments, advisory work and ad hoc reviews where compliance testing or financial control insight is required. Key requirements (Communication/skills/experience) Prior experience in either compliance, financial analysis, internal audit, finance assurance, financial controls testing or a related discipline, ideally within a professional services firm, large corporate environment, public practice or similar organisation. Experience with data analytics, including strong excel skills, and knowledge of management information reporting. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with confidence in reviewing large volumes of data, identifying exceptions and investigating root causes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain findings clearly and engage constructively with stakeholders at different levels. Strong attention to detail and high levels of professionalism, integrity and objectivity. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and follow reviews through to clear outcomes. Confident working collaboratively across teams, including Finance, Financial Systems, Data, Risk and Compliance, and business stakeholders. An enquiring mind and a practical, improvement-focused approach, rather than only following a pre-determined checklist. Desirable Experience within a law firm or similar professional services partnership will be considered positively A good understanding of financial processes and controls, with an ability to identify compliance risks, control weaknesses and practical improvement opportunities. Experience of performing testing, monitoring or assurance work over policies, procedures, approvals, access controls or financial processes. Exposure to travel and expenses, billing, matter management, banking, systems access, sanctions, Client Due Diligence, gifts and hospitality, or anti-bribery and corruption compliance. Experience using data analytics, dashboards or technology-enabled assurance techniques to improve monitoring and reporting. Experience working in a global or multi-jurisdictional environment. Experience using AI to effectively accelerate assurance, compliance monitoring or reporting work, while being mindful of the risks and limitations. Experience designing Power BI dashboards, compliance scorecards, KPI/KRI reporting or executive management information. Experience reviewing general IT controls including: ISO27001, NIST, user access (including management of joiner and leavers), segregation of duties, information security, cyber security and personal data. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of background. All offers of employment will be conditional on the candidate having/securing the right to work in the UK in the role in question and providing the firm with evidence of that right (as required by the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006) prior to employment commencing. Freshfields is a Ban the Box employer. We ask applicants to disclose criminal convictions only if and when a conditional job offer is made. A conviction does not automatically lead to withdrawal of the offer: we make decisions on a case-by-case basis and take a number of relevant factors into account (e.g. the role you are applying for and the circumstances of the offence). You would have the opportunity to discuss the matter with us before we make a decision.

title: Associate Regulatory Public Law and Foreign Direct Investment (f/m/x)
description: Associate Regulatory Public Law and Foreign Direct Investment (m/f/x) We are looking for committed and highly qualified associates (f/m/x) with a special interest in public law and foreign direct investment to support our team in Vienna. Your Tasks In your future position, you will advise national and international clients on a wide range of questions, with a focus on: Regulatory Public Law: Offering expert advice on leading national and international clients on a broad range of public and regulatory law matters with focus on cutting-edge topics including product regulation such as food & beverages, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, mobility, digitalisation and energy law. Foreign Direct Investment: As part of our team, you will work at the forefront of one of the most dynamic and fast-evolving areas of international law and advise a high-profile client base - including multinational corporates, private equity funds, sovereign wealth funds and other international investors - on FDI control in complex, sensitive and multi-jurisdictional projects and transactions. Your work will include: Delivering ad hoc advice on complex and strategic regulatory public law matters, frequently in the context of upcoming legislative changes and evolving legal frameworks Supporting regulatory public law aspects of transactions across highly and less regulated industries, including trade law as well as law advice in respect of industrial facilities, water law and other sector-specific regulatory requirements Preparing written submissions and support litigation strategy in administrative court proceedings, and advise on product recalls and compliance with applicable product regulatory regimes Advising clients on FDI filing requirements and investment screening processes under the Austrian Investment Control Act ( Investitionskontrollgesetz ) Preparing and managing investment control applications in highly sensitive sectors, including defence, energy infrastructure, data centres, telecommunications, healthcare, and artificial intelligence Coordinating FDI filings across multiple jurisdictions to secure regulatory approvals for cross-border M&A transactions - working hand in hand with Freshfields colleagues in London, Brussels, Berlin, Paris, Washington and beyond Representing clients in administrative proceedings before the Federal Ministry for Economy, Labour and Tourism as well as representing and assisting clients in national and EU proceedings, including before higher administrative and constitutional courts Monitoring and analysing legislative developments in the regulatory public law and foreign direct investment (FDI) sector at the Austrian and EU levels. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, attention to detail, and dedication to quality legal advice, as well as strong analytical skills and a genuine interest in regulatory, policy and geopolitical developments. Experience abroad or specialized knowledge in these areas (e.g., through an LL.M., dissertation, internships, university / research assistant roles, or law firm experience) is advantageous but not a must. Work in a dynamic, international environment with direct access to Freshfields' global network of specialists. You will gain early responsibility and direct client exposure in high-profile matters. Benefit from outstanding learning and development opportunities tailored to your growth (including internal bar exam preparation courses and soft law skills trainings). As additional benefits, we also provide an annual public transport pass, access to an on-site gym, regular networking events, and well-being programs. Did we get you interested? title: Junior Adviseur Waterbouw

Wat deze functie uniek maakt, is dat je niet alleen adviezen opstelt, maar ook samenwerkt met de specialisten die het grondonderzoek, de monitoring en de analyses uitvoeren. Daardoor krijg je inzicht in de volledige geotechnische keten. Innovatie speelt een belangrijke rol binnen ons werk. We ontwikkelen en implementeren nieuwe technieken, zoals geautomatiseerde rekentools, innovatieve meetmethoden en eigen onderzoeksinstrumenten, waaronder de gepatenteerde Aquisense-sondering en erosieproeven. Je bent betrokken bij dijkversterkingsprojecten in alle fasen: van veiligheidsbeoordelingen en ontwerpopgaven tot uitvoering en realisatie. title: Ingeniero CPT
description: Job Description Realizar ensayos relacionados al equipo de penetración con sistema de empuje hidráulico para instrumentos tipo CPT: sísmico down-hole, conductividad eléctrica, veleta de corte, toma de muestras. Delegación de tareas a ayudantes y coordinación. Todo de acuerdo con los estándares establecidos por la empresa para los proyectos tanto en la parte operacional, calidad, salud y seguridad. Responsabilidades: Persona que efectúa todos los trabajos y actividades propias de una obra de sondaje con sistema de empuje hidráulico, de acuerdo con las indicaciones dadas por el jefe de turno de la faena. Encargado de la planificación, programación y cumplimiento de la campaña sondaje CPT, ensayos asociados y despliegue de vehículos que portan la mesa de empuje. Encargado de dar respuesta al cliente/ITO respecto a los parámetros y solicitudes técnicas de los ensayos CPT. Responsable de la calidad en la adquisición de datos mediante los ensayos con mesa de empuje: CPT, Sísmicos Down-Hole, Conductividad Eléctrica, Veleta de Corte, Toma de Muestra (Direct push y MOSTAP) y otros. Asegurar la calidad y cuidado de los ensayos realizados, coordinar las muestras tomadas para control, marcaje y parámetros que considere importante desde toma de muestra hasta llegada a laboratorio. Ejecuta servicios de limpieza, identificación, traslado, conservación y entrega materiales, instrumentos y herramientas relacionadas al equipo. Eventualmente realiza trabajos de movimientos de tierra y excavaciones manuales con pala y chuzo. Su función es de vital importancia porque sobre él recae la responsabilidad de guiar de manera segura los movimientos de barra y otros propios del equipo CPT. Eventualmente puede manipular los movimientos de barra y otros para la realización de los ensayos CPT. Manejar la normativa de ensayos de penetración, tener criterio y orientar a clientes para optimizar los resultados. Conducción de vehículo liviano, siempre con previa autorización. Informar los desvíos operacionales, accidentes o incidentes ocurridos con prontitud a su mando superior. Coordinar con el cliente y su supervisión los traslados y planificación del equipo CPT, participar activamente en pro de mejorar los rendimientos en terreno. Puede explicar los principios físicos y mecánicos de los ensayos a realizar. Verificar estado de calibración y mantenimiento del equipo e instrumentos. Revisar con antelación y previa planificación de los instrumentos y equipo de trabajo para que se encuentren funcionando en óptimas condiciones, conocer su funcionamiento, manipulación y cuidados. Difundir junto a su equipo el procedimiento de trabajo y la planificación de actividades por proyecto, turno o diarias. Velar por los equipos en resguardo y protección. Realizar informes técnicos de avance y resultados de los ensayos ejecutados durante la faena y/o proyecto. Asegurar que la información adquirida se respalde pronta y adecuadamente según el flujo de trabajo de digitalización estandarizado por la compañía. Informar a su supervisión con antelación las actividades a realizar en caso de faltar herramientas, equipos o materiales para evitar detenciones operacionales. Informa a su jefatura directa o indirecta de defectos o fallas, condición insegura o sub- estándar en herramientas o instalaciones, que puede ser causa de lesiones a las personas o daño al equipo e instalaciones. Debe participar activamente en la verificación de ART/AST antes de cada jornada de trabajo, como también verificar los check-list generados con apoyo de operador y ayudantes. Reportar desviaciones y solicitar al área de operaciones sean corregidas. Cumple con el Reglamento Interno de Orden, Higiene y Seguridad. Debe cuidar y hacer uso obligatorio de sus elementos de protección personal, además de hacer cumplir el uso de ellos a su personal a cargo. Garantiza el orden y limpieza de las instalaciones, mediante el uso de recursos a su alcance. title: GNSS Support & Test Engineer
description: Job Description Fugro builds the positioning products behind critical geodata operations worldwide. Our team engineers Fugro's proprietary correction services and positioning engines into products spanning hardware and software: StarPack, our GNSS receiver platform deployed on vessels across the globe, and MultiFix, the real-time positioning and QC solution within the Starfix software suite. We are now building the next generation of resilient PNT: positioning that stays accurate and trustworthy under jamming, spoofing and signal denial. We are looking for an engineer who makes sure all of it works — and proves it. You will own the testing of our GNSS software and hardware, build an AI-driven test harness around it, and act as the technical backbone of our product support. You will work AI-native: coding agents, LLM-assisted tooling and automated pipelines will be your default way of working here — whether you bring that habit with you or build it with us. You will join a small, senior team of development engineers led by an engineering manager, in a role that closes the loop between building and verifying. Your role You test GNSS hardware and software end to end, including receiver platforms (StarPack), positioning and QC software (MultiFix/Starfix), firmware releases, correction services and output formats, both on the bench and in hardware-in-the-loop setups; You engineer and operate the RF/receiver test loop by recording real-world signal and interference environments, replaying them against receivers and antennas under test using GNSS simulation and record & playback equipment, and translating results into repeatable, documented test procedures; You own, maintain and document the GNSS hardware test environment, including bench setups, hardware-in-the-loop rigs, RF/simulator equipment and record & playback systems, ensuring they remain calibrated and available; You build and expand the AI test harness, including LLM-assisted test generation, automated regression testing across firmware and receiver-card variants, self-healing test suites and automated failure triage with structured, actionable output; You organize the flow of test and field data to the positioning engine development team by consolidating conversion tools, defining delivery formats, and creating AI-assisted scripts and tooling for reliable dataset conversion, validation and handover; You provide 2nd and 3rd line support by resolving escalated technical issues, reproducing complex faults in the lab, performing root-cause analysis and feeding structural fixes back to the development team. You capture and share knowledge through runbooks, knowledge-base articles and test documentation, while occasionally travelling for field data-recording campaigns and visits to vessels or regional operations. Your track record You hold a Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Geodesy, Navigation Technology, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline; You bring at least 3 years of relevant engineering experience and have a strong GNSS foundation, including multi-constellation and multi-frequency positioning, PPP/RTK/DGNSS concepts, correction services, and protocol-level knowledge of NMEA, RTCM and raw receiver logs; You handle GNSS data confidently, including RINEX, IQ recordings and proprietary log formats, as well as format conversion, batch processing and validation; You communicate fluently in English, both written and oral. Dutch is not required. Nice to have: You have hands-on hardware experience with GNSS receivers, antennas, RF cabling, signal generators, simulators and hardware-in-the-loop testing; You have experience with scripting and test automation, including CI-integrated test pipelines, regardless of the programming language used; You work in an AI-native way, leveraging coding agents and LLM-based tooling to build, test and automate solutions, or you are eager to adopt this approach; You bring a support-oriented mindset, combining structured troubleshooting, clear communication and persistence in reproducing and resolving complex issues; You have experience with Software Defined Radio (SDR), GNSS simulators such as Spirent, jamming and spoofing test scenarios, and collaborating within distributed teams. description: Job Description No matter your project or industry, understanding the Earth is key. Why?
